def place_on_zone_v1(obj_name, zone_name):
    obs = observe()
    obj = obs["objects"][obj_name]
    zone = obs["zones"][zone_name]
    
    pick(obj["name"], 0.05, obj["long_axis_yaw"])
    place(zone["name"], 0.0, 0.0)
skills.expected_effect: object resting inside the zone footprint, gripper open, arm lifted
